build_light_dialog_dataset: build a ParlAI Light Dialog dataset from pickle databases with train, valid, test splits
generate_no_affordance_actions: generate all possible no-affordance actions for a dialogue turn given room objects and carrying state
write_dialog_messages: write dialogue messages to a file with configurable features like speech, action, emote, and persona
fix_label_candidates: fix label candidates by clipping to a max size and ensuring the gold label is included
write_out_candidates: write out all unique candidate labels for emote, speech, action, and which types to text files
